name: Snake, Cobra (King)
body:
Venomous snakes are generally far more aggressive than constrictor snakes, and even larger variants do exist: you can create stats for a king cobra, for example, by applying the advanced and giant simple templates.
Giant Venomous Snake (King Cobra)	CR 3
XP 400
Advanced giant venomous snake
N Large animal
Init +6; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +11

DEFENSE
AC 18, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +7 natural, -1 size)
hp 21 (2d8+12)
Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +3

OFFENSE
Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +5 (1d6+7 plus poison)

STATISTICS
Str 20, Dex 15, Con 22, Int 1, Wis 17, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +7; CMD 19 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Acrobatics +10, Climb +13, Perception +11, Stealth +6, Swim +13; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth, +8 Acrobatics

SPECIAL ABILITIES
Poison (Ex)
Bite—injury; save Fort DC 17; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Con; cure 1 save.
